title: IAP transaction billed but items not delivered to user account
symptoms: IAP payment deducted item not delivered
User was charged but gems/coins were not credited
Pending transactions lingering in store queue
causes: Calling `finishTransaction` / `consumeAsync` before local/server inventory is securely saved
Missing transaction listener on game startup to process pending/interrupted purchases

solution.action: Initialize a persistent Transaction Observer on game startup to catch pending purchases.
Never call `finishTransaction` / `consumeAsync` until item is confirmed and saved.
Provide a 'Restore Purchases' button in Settings.

prevention: Test IAP flow under network disconnect and app force-kill scenarios in sandbox mode.
